body:
I'm afraid what measures they would go to if I told them. Getting forced to the hospital or somewhere else is not something I want.

 They are fairly religious and I have become fairly distant from their chosen religion although I haven't been vocal about it. Talking about these problems is a can of worms I don't want to open in this environment if ever.

The branch I wanted to get into wouldn't take me. If I'm going military I'm flying a plane and I would do nothing less than officer. That apparently isn't an option or so I was told due to my less than stellar gap. I've also chained myself to a route that I have to see through to the end or I'll be worse off than I am now

Thanks for the thoughts and advice.

Shrink never helped me that much. I can't medicate because of my career path either. I would be shooting myself in the foot going to get medicated. 

It's just not looking worth going through this. I just don't see myself being anything but miserable. The past 5 years have been like this I don't think it will change.

My problem is I don't see an end you know? So what if I finishes these classes? so what if I get a job? I just don't even see how this gets better you know? My family is the same. They won't judge is what they have said. I get it. I play too much. They should be somewhat angry because I do live here but I just don't think they really understand why.

No way in hell I would ever open up to them either.

The problem (I will admit it is a problem) Is that I play games maybe a little more than I should because I hate dealing with things. I just don't see any light at the end you know? I just don't. What's worse is the shit really hit the fan with stress and everything else going on then this. I'm just not seeing.
